title: Avanafil mediated dual inhibition of IKKbeta and TNFR1 in an experimental paradigm of Alzheimer's disease: in silico and in vivo approach.
authors: Chowdari Gurram, Prasada; Satarker, Sairaj; Kumar, Gautam; Begum, Farmiza; Mehta, Chetan; Nayak, Usha; Mudgal, Jayesh; Arora, Devinder; Nampoothiri, Madhavan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟探究药物avanafil对IKKbeta和TNFR1的双重抑制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作模拟，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移性有限，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: In Alzheimer's disease pathology, inhibitors of nuclear factor kappa-beta kinase subunit beta (IKKB) and Tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 (TNFR1) signaling are linked to neuroinflammation-mediated cognitive decline. We explored the role of a phosphodiesterase 5 inhibitor (PDE5I) with dual antagonistic action on IKKB and TNFR1 to inhibit nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kB) and curb neuroinflammation. In the in silico approach, the FDA-approved Zinc 15 library was docked with IKKB and TNFR1. The top compound with dual antagonistic action on IKKB and TNFR1 was selected based on bonding and non-bonding interactions. Further, induced fit docking (IFD), molecular mechanics-generalized Born and surface area (MMGBSA), and molecular dynamic studies were carried out and evaluated. Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) administration caused a neuroinflammation-mediated cognitive decline in mice. Two doses of avanafil were administered for 28 days while LPS was administered for 10 days. Morris water maze (MWM) along with the passive avoidance test (PAT) were carried out. Concurrently brain levels of inflammatory markers, oxidative parameters, amyloid beta (Abeta), IKKB and NF-kB levels were estimated. Avanafil produced good IKKB and TNFR1 binding ability. It interacted with crucial inhibitory amino acids of IKKB and TNFR1. MD analysis predicted good stability of avanafil with TNFR1 and IKKB. Avanafil 6 mg/kg could significantly improve performance in MWM, PAT and oxidative parameters and reduce Abeta levels and inflammatory markers. As compared to avanafil 3 mg/kg, 6 mg/kg dose was found to exert better efficacy against elevated Abeta , neuroinflammatory cytokines and oxidative markers while improving behavioural parameters.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 在阿尔茨海默病病理过程中，核因子κB激酶亚基β抑制剂（IKKB）和肿瘤坏死因子受体1（TNFR1）信号通路与神经炎症介导的认知衰退相关。我们探讨了一种具有IKKB和TNFR1双重拮抗作用的磷酸二酯酶5抑制剂（PDE5I）在抑制核因子κB（NF-kB）及遏制神经炎症中的作用。在计算机模拟方法中，将FDA批准的Zinc 15文库与IKKB和TNFR1进行对接。基于成键和非成键相互作用，选择了对IKKB和TNFR1具有双重拮抗作用的顶级化合物。进一步进行了诱导拟合对接（IFD）、分子力学-广义Born和表面积（MMGBSA）以及分子动力学研究并进行了评估。脂多糖（LPS）给药导致小鼠神经炎症介导的认知衰退。给予两种剂量的阿伐那非，持续28天，而LPS给药持续10天。进行了莫里斯水迷宫（MWM）和被动回避测试（PAT）。同时评估了脑内炎症标志物、氧化参数、淀粉样β（Abeta）、IKKB和NF-kB水平。阿伐那非表现出良好的IKKB和TNFR1结合能力。它与IKKB和TNFR1的关键抑制性氨基酸相互作用。分子动力学分析预测阿伐那非与TNFR1和IKKB具有良好的稳定性。阿伐那非6 mg/kg能显著改善MWM、PAT表现及氧化参数，并降低Abeta水平和炎症标志物。与阿伐那非3 mg/kg相比，6 mg/kg剂量在对抗升高的Abeta、神经炎症细胞因子和氧化标志物方面表现出更好的疗效，同时改善行为参数。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
